Woh phonetic layout jo Pakistan mein zyada tar log istemaal karte hain: a se ا, b se ب, p se پ, t se ت, Shift+T se ٹ. Aarab Shift par hain: Y zabar, I zer, P pesh, W shadd, Q jazm.
Type Arabic with the Arabic (101) layout: Arabic (101) layout se Arabi likhein, computer par install kiye baghair. Saudi Arab mein istemaal hone wala Windows ka standard Arabi layout: h se ا, f se ب, j se ت, b se لا. Harakaat Shift par hain: Q fatha, A kasra, E damma, X sukun, ` shadda.
Type Persian with the Persian (Standard,: Persian (Standard, ISIRI 9147) layout se Farsi likhein, computer par install kiye baghair. Windows jaisa Farsi standard layout (ISIRI 9147): d se ی, ; se ک, ' se گ. Shift+Space se half space (ZWNJ) likhi jaati hai.
Type Punjabi (Shahmukhi) with the Punjab: Punjabi Shahmukhi (Phonetic) layout se Punjabi (Shahmukhi) likhein, computer par install kiye baghair. Punjabi huroof ke saath Urdu Phonetic layout: Shift+B ݨ, Shift+L ڵ, AltGr+L ݪ, AltGr+Y ۓ.
Show the keys of the Urdu, Arabic, Persi: Urdu, Arabi, Farsi ya Punjabi keyboard ki keys screen par dikhayein. Likhne ke liye kisi key par click karein; Shift aarab aur mazeed huroof dikhata hai.
Choose the typing keyboard and where it: File → Options → Zabaan mein likhne ka keyboard chunein, aur yeh bhi ke woh kahan likhe.
English ⇄ the last right-to-left keyboar: English ⇄ aakhri daayein se baayein keyboard (Urdu, Arabi, Farsi ya Punjabi). Kuch install nahin karna.
Type Urdu, Arabic, Persian or Punjabi (S: Urdu, Arabi, Farsi ya Punjabi (Shahmukhi) us layout se likhein jo log sab se zyada istemaal karte hain, install kiye baghair.
See every key of the layout. Click a key: Layout ki har key dekhein. Likhne ke liye kisi key par click karein; Shift aarab dikhata hai.
Likhne ka keyboard aur woh kahan likhta hai.
Woh layout jis mein aap ki keys documents mein likhti hain. Computer par kuch install nahin hota.
Type Urdu, Arabic, Persian or Punjabi wi: Keyboard install kiye baghair Urdu, Arabi, Farsi ya Punjabi likhein. Kisi bhi waqt status bar par ya Ctrl+Shift+K se badlein.
The right-to-left keyboard that Ctrl+Shi: Woh daayein se baayein keyboard jis par Ctrl+Shift+K aur status bar le jaate hain.
Ctrl+Shift+K and the status bar switch b: Ctrl+Shift+K aur status bar English aur is keyboard ke darmiyan badalte hain.
Also type in search boxes and dialogs: Talaash ke box aur dialogs mein bhi likhein
Off: only the document uses the keyboard: Off: keyboard sirf document mein kaam karta hai, is liye command talaash (Alt+Q) aur “Talaash karein” English huroof mein rehte hain.
Keys with their letters at the bottom of: Window ke neeche huroof wali keys. Likhne ke liye kisi key par click karein.
Already have an Urdu, Arabic or Persian: Kya aap ke computer par pehle se Urdu, Arabi ya Farsi keyboard hai? Yahan English rehne dein aur apna keyboard istemaal karein: jo keys pehle se yeh huroof likhti hain, Markooj unhein kabhi nahin badalta.
Add zabar (fatha, ◌َ) to the letter befo: Cursor se pehle wale harf par zabar (fatha, ◌َ) lagayein. Dobara click karne se alamat hat jayegi.
Adds zabar (fatha) to the letter before: Cursor se pehle wale harf par zabar (fatha) lagata hai. Dobara click karne se alamat hat jaati hai.
Add zer (kasra, ◌ِ) to the letter before: Cursor se pehle wale harf par zer (kasra, ◌ِ) lagayein. Dobara click karne se alamat hat jayegi.
Adds zer (kasra) to the letter before th: Cursor se pehle wale harf par zer (kasra) lagata hai. Dobara click karne se alamat hat jaati hai.
Add pesh (damma, ◌ُ) to the letter befor: Cursor se pehle wale harf par pesh (damma, ◌ُ) lagayein. Dobara click karne se alamat hat jayegi.
Adds pesh (damma) to the letter before t: Cursor se pehle wale harf par pesh (damma) lagata hai. Dobara click karne se alamat hat jaati hai.
Add shadd (shadda, tashdid, ◌ّ) to the l: Cursor se pehle wale harf par shadd (shadda, tashdeed, ◌ّ) lagayein. Dobara click karne se alamat hat jayegi.
Adds shadd (shadda, tashdid) to the lett: Cursor se pehle wale harf par shadd (shadda, tashdeed) lagata hai. Dobara click karne se alamat hat jaati hai.
Add jazm (sukun, ◌ْ) to the letter befor: Cursor se pehle wale harf par jazm (sukun, ◌ْ) lagayein. Dobara click karne se alamat hat jayegi.
Adds jazm (sukun) to the letter before t: Cursor se pehle wale harf par jazm (sukun) lagata hai. Dobara click karne se alamat hat jaati hai.
Add tanween zabar (fathatan, do zabar, ◌: Cursor se pehle wale harf par tanween zabar (fathatan, do zabar, ◌ً) lagayein. Dobara click karne se alamat hat jayegi.
Adds tanween zabar (fathatan, do zabar): Cursor se pehle wale harf par tanween zabar (fathatan, do zabar) lagata hai. Dobara click karne se alamat hat jaati hai.
Add tanween zer (kasratan, do zer, ◌ٍ) t: Cursor se pehle wale harf par tanween zer (kasratan, do zer, ◌ٍ) lagayein. Dobara click karne se alamat hat jayegi. Screen keyboard (Manzar → Screen par) mein bhi hai.
Adds tanween zer (kasratan, do zer) to t: Cursor se pehle wale harf par tanween zer (kasratan, do zer) lagata hai. Dobara click karne se alamat hat jaati hai.
Add tanween pesh (dammatan, do pesh, ◌ٌ): Cursor se pehle wale harf par tanween pesh (dammatan, do pesh, ◌ٌ) lagayein. Dobara click karne se alamat hat jayegi. Screen keyboard (Manzar → Screen par) mein bhi hai.
Adds tanween pesh (dammatan, do pesh) to: Cursor se pehle wale harf par tanween pesh (dammatan, do pesh) lagata hai. Dobara click karne se alamat hat jaati hai.
Add khari zabar (superscript alef, ◌ٰ) t: Cursor se pehle wale harf par khari zabar (upar chhota alif, ◌ٰ) lagayein. Dobara click karne se alamat hat jayegi.
Adds khari zabar (superscript alef) to t: Cursor se pehle wale harf par khari zabar (upar chhota alif) lagata hai. Dobara click karne se alamat hat jaati hai.
Pehle koi document kholein ya banayein.
Use Edit as text to make an editable cop: Pehle “Text ke taur par tarmeem” se tarmeem ke qaabil copy banayein.
Yeh document sirf parhne ke liye hai.
Aarab lagane ke liye document kholein.
Put the cursor right after a letter, the: Cursor ko kisi harf ke foran baad rakhein, phir alamat lagayein.

Removed {count} aarab marks from the sel.one: Chune hue hisse se aarab ki {count} alamat hata di gayi.
Removed {count} aarab marks from the sel.other: Chune hue hisse se aarab ki {count} alamaat hata di gayin.

The selection has no aarab. Select text: Chune hue hisse mein aarab nahin hain. Aarab wala text chunein, ya poora document saaf karne ke liye kuch chune baghair click karein.

Removed {count} aarab marks from the doc.one: Document se aarab ki {count} alamat hata di gayi.
Removed {count} aarab marks from the doc.other: Document se aarab ki {count} alamaat hata di gayin.

This document has no aarab to remove. Co: Is document mein hatane ke liye aarab nahin hain. Code blocks hamesha waise hi rehte hain.
Install the Urdu, Arabic or Punjabi lang: Alfaaz ki list se aarab lagane ke liye Urdu, Arabi ya Punjabi ka zabaan pack install karein.
Update the language pack to a version wi: Zabaan pack ko alfaaz ki list wale version par update karein, phir dobara koshish karein.

Added aarab to {count} words in the sele.one: Chune hue hisse mein {count} lafz par aarab lag gaye.
Added aarab to {count} words in the sele.other: Chune hue hisse mein {count} alfaaz par aarab lag gaye.

Added aarab to {count} words in the docu.one: Document mein {count} lafz par aarab lag gaye.
Added aarab to {count} words in the docu.other: Document mein {count} alfaaz par aarab lag gaye.

No word in the selection has a single kn: Chune hue hisse ke kisi lafz ka abhi ek hi maloom talaffuz nahin.
No word in the document has a single kno: Document ke kisi lafz ka abhi ek hi maloom talaffuz nahin.

{count} words have more than one reading.one: {count} lafz ke ek se zyada talaffuz hain, is liye woh jaisa likha tha waisa hi raha: us ki alamaat buttons se lagayein.
{count} words have more than one reading.other: {count} alfaaz ke ek se zyada talaffuz hain, is liye woh jaise likhe the waise hi rahe: un ki alamaat buttons se lagayein.

Switch to Read mode to see the text with: Aarab ke baghair text dekhne ke liye Parhne ke mode par jayein. Word aur Inline mode mein alamaat nazar aati rehti hain taake aap un mein tarmeem kar sakein.
Aarab hidden on screen. Your file keeps: Screen par aarab chhup gaye. Aap ki file mein woh maujood hain.
Aarab dobara nazar aa rahe hain.
Remove zabar, zer, pesh, shadd, jazm, ta: Chune hue hisse se, ya kuch na chuna ho to poore document se, zabar, zer, pesh, shadd, jazm, tanween aur khari zabar hatayein. Code waisa hi rehta hai; “Wapas lein” alamaat wapas le aata hai.
Remove every zabar, zer, pesh, shadd, ja: Document se har zabar, zer, pesh, shadd, jazm, tanween aur khari zabar hatayein. Code waisa hi rehta hai; “Wapas lein” inhein wapas le aata hai.
Show the text without aarab in Read mode: Aasaani se parhne ke liye Parhne ke mode aur Saada mode ki jhalak mein text aarab ke baghair dikhayein. File mein alamaat maujood rehti hain. Dobara click karne se woh phir nazar aayengi.
Add aarab from the word list: Alfaaz ki list se aarab lagayein
Add aarab to the words of the selection: Chune hue hisse (ya poore document) ke un alfaaz par aarab lagayein jin ka Urdu, Arabi ya Punjabi alfaaz ki list mein theek ek talaffuz maujood hai. Kai talaffuz wale alfaaz waise hi rehte hain jaise likhe gaye.
From the selection, or the whole documen: Chune hue hisse se, ya kuch na chuna ho to poore document se. “Wapas lein” inhein wapas le aata hai.
Every mark in the document; code stays a: Document ki har alamat; code waisa hi rehta hai.
Parhne ka mode text aarab ke baghair dikhata hai. File mein woh maujood rehte hain.
Only for words with one known reading in: Sirf un alfaaz ke liye jin ka zabaan pack mein ek hi maloom talaffuz hai.
Buttons for zabar, zer, pesh, shadd, jaz: Zabar, zer, pesh, shadd, jazm, tanween aur khari zabar, “Aarab hatayein” aur “Aarab chhupayein” ke buttons. “Khudkaar” inhein us waqt dikhata hai jab aap Urdu, Arabi, Farsi ya Punjabi likh rahe hon.
When the Aarab buttons show on the Home: Aarab ke buttons Home tab par kab nazar aayen. Commands hamesha Alt+Q mein maujood hain.
Hide aarab in Read mode: Parhne ke mode mein aarab chhupayein
Read mode and the Simple mode preview sh: Parhne ka mode aur Saada mode ki jhalak text alamaat ke baghair dikhate hain. Aap ki file mein woh maujood rehti hain.
Use Edit as text to make an editable cop: “Text ke taur par tarmeem” se tarmeem ke qaabil copy banayein. PDF aur DjVu files mein yahan tarmeem nahin ho sakti.
Press Esc to go back to editing, then in: Tarmeem par wapas jaane ke liye Esc dabayein, phir tareekh daakhil karein. Parhne ka mode document nahin badalta.
Language of month and day names: Maheenon aur dinon ke naamon ki zabaan
yyyy year · MM month (MMMM name) · dd da: yyyy saal · MM maheena (MMMM naam) · dd din (dddd naam) · HH ya h ghanta · mm minute · a AM/PM · 'text' jaisa likha
Include the day name: Din ka naam bhi shaamil karein
Hijri dates follow the Umm al-Qura calen: Hijri tareekhein Umm al-Qura calendar ke mutaabiq hain. Jahan naya chaand ek din baad nazar aata hai, jaise Pakistan mein, wahan upar “Hijri tareekh” mein “Ek din pehle” chunein.
Date format for Alt+Shift+D: Alt+Shift+D ke liye tareekh ka format
Alt+Shift+D and /today use this format: Alt+Shift+D aur /today yahi format istemaal karte hain
Double-click a day or press Ctrl+Enter t: Daakhil karne ke liye kisi din par double-click karein ya Ctrl+Enter dabayein
Pick a date on a calendar and a format:: Calendar par tareekh aur format chunein: 27/11/2026, November 27, 2026, 20261127, ISO, Hijri tareekh, waqt, ya apna pattern. Alt+Shift+D aakhri format mein tareekh daakhil karta hai.
Insert today’s date in the format you us: Aaj ki tareekh us format mein daakhil karein jo aap ne aakhri baar istemaal kiya (Daakhil karein → Tareekh aur waqt mein set hota hai). /today likhne se bhi yahi hota hai.
Insert the time now, 12-hour or 24-hour: Abhi ka waqt daakhil karein, 12 ya 24 ghante wala, jaisa Daakhil karein → Tareekh aur waqt mein chuna gaya. /time likhne se bhi yahi hota hai.
Insert today’s Hijri (Islamic) date, wit: Aaj ki Hijri (Islami) tareekh daakhil karein, maheenon ke naam English, Urdu ya Arabi mein. /hijri likhne se bhi yahi hota hai.
Pick a date on a calendar and a format,: Calendar par tareekh aur format chunein, Eeswi ya Hijri, maheenon ke naam English, Urdu ya Arabi mein. Alt+Shift+D tareekh aur Alt+Shift+T waqt aakhri istemaal kiye gaye format mein daakhil karta hai.
Alt+Shift+D aur /today “{date}” daakhil karte hain. Alt+Shift+T aur /time “{time}” daakhil karte hain.
Enter to insert · Esc to close: Enter se daakhil · Esc se band
Use Insert → Date & time instead. The da: Is ki bajaye Daakhil karein → Tareekh aur waqt istemaal karein. Is window mein tareekh ke tools load nahin hue.
Select the whole document: the Markdown: Poora document chunein: Saada mode mein Markdown, aur Word, Inline aur Parhne ke mode mein safha. Ribbon aur khaaka shaamil nahin hote.
Open or create a document first, then se: Pehle document kholein ya banayein, phir us ka text chunein.
Press Esc to go back to editing, then pa: Tarmeem par wapas jaane ke liye Esc dabayein, phir paste karein. Parhne ka mode document nahin badalta.
Paste the words on the clipboard without: Clipboard ke alfaaz un ke fonts, rangon, links ya tables ke baghair paste karein. Ctrl+Alt+V se bhi.
Copy some text first, then paste it as p: Pehle kuch text copy karein, phir usay saade text ke taur par paste karein. Is waqt clipboard mein koi text nahin.
Close brackets and quotes automatically: Brackets aur quotes khud band karein
Typing ( [ { or a quote adds the closing: ( [ { ya quote likhne se band karne wala bhi aa jaata hai aur cursor dono ke darmiyan rehta hai. Band karne wala likhne par cursor us se aage nikal jaata hai, chuna hua hissa un ke andar aa jaata hai, aur Backspace khaali jora mita deta hai.
Close Markdown marks too: Markdown ki alamaat bhi band karein
In Simple and Inline mode, * _ ` and ~~: Saada aur Inline mode mein * _ ` aur ~~ bhi khud band hote hain: **bold** ke liye ** likhein. Satar ke shuru mein * bullet hi rehta hai.
Typing $ adds the closing $ for an equat: $ likhne se equation ke liye band karne wala $ aa jaata hai. Agar foran baad number ho ($5) to dollar ka nishaan waisa hi rehta hai jaisa likha.
Type /today, /time, /hijri or /date and: /today, /time, /hijri ya /date likhein aur Space ya Enter dabayein. Ek chhoti list options dikhati hai; Esc usay band karta hai.
Put the cursor in a word or select some: Pehle cursor kisi lafz mein rakhein ya kuch text chunein, phir agla match chunne ke liye Ctrl+D dabayein.
Type to change every selected match at o: Tamam chune hue matches ek saath badalne ke liye likhein, ya ek cursor ke liye Esc dabayein. Tamam matches chun liye gaye hain.
Select other text to look for, or press: Talaash ke liye koi aur text chunein, ya Esc dabayein. Koi aur match nahin hai.
Put the cursor in a word or select some: Pehle cursor kisi lafz mein rakhein ya kuch text chunein, phir har match chunne ke liye Alt+F3 dabayein.
Select other text to look for, or press: Talaash ke liye koi aur text chunein, ya Esc dabayein. Bas yahi ek match hai.
Open a Markdown document first. Multiple: Pehle Markdown document kholein. Kai cursors Saada mode mein kaam karte hain.
Switch to Simple mode (Ctrl+3) to use {f: {feature} istemaal karne ke liye Saada mode (Ctrl+3) par jayein. Word aur Inline mode mein ek cursor hota hai; Saada mode mein aap jitne chahein cursors se Markdown mein tarmeem kar sakte hain.
Simple mode: select the word at the curs: Saada mode: cursor wala lafz chunein, phir har agla match ek naye cursor ke saath. Sab ek saath badalne ke liye likhein. Esc se wapas ek cursor.
Simple mode: put a cursor on every match: Saada mode: chune hue text (ya cursor wale lafz) ke har match par cursor rakhein. Kai cursors hon to Ctrl+Shift+L bhi yahi karta hai.
Simple mode: add a cursor on the line ab: Saada mode: upar wali satar mein usi column par cursor shaamil karein. Alt+click se kahin bhi cursor shaamil hota hai.
Simple mode: add a cursor on the line be: Saada mode: neeche wali satar mein usi column par cursor shaamil karein. Alt+click se kahin bhi cursor shaamil hota hai.
Remove the extra cursors and keep the la: Izaafi cursors hatayein aur aakhri wala rehne dein.
There is only one cursor now. Ctrl+D, Ct: Ab sirf ek cursor hai. Saada mode mein Ctrl+D, Ctrl+Alt+Up ya Down, ya Alt+click se mazeed cursors shaamil karein.
